steps.en: OCMS confirms the notice has no permanent suspension yet
steps.id: OCMS memastikan notice belum punya permanent suspension

steps.en: OCMS validates the request before suspending
OCMS applies the permanent suspension with the requested code
steps.id: OCMS menerapkan permanent suspension dengan kode yang diminta

steps.en: Each notice in a batch is suspended with its own number
steps.id: Tiap notice dalam satu batch di-suspend dengan nomornya sendiri

steps.en: OCMS sends PLUS a success status
steps.id: OCMS mengirim status berhasil ke PLUS
